definition: A blawg is a slang term to describe an online journal or log which focuses primarily on law-related issues. Typically, blawgs are authored by law professors, lawyers, or law students. Blawgs can either discuss the law in the general sense or focus their posts on a specific field/issue. Examples of popular blawgs include: SCOTUSblog, AboveTheLaw, and The Volokh Conspiracy.
